title: BCL7B, a SWI/SNF complex subunit, orchestrates cancer immunity and stemness.
authors: Higuchi, Sayaka; Suehiro, Yuji; Izuhara, Luna; Yoshina, Sawako; Hirasawa, Akira; Mitani, Shohei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SWI/SNF亚基BCL7B对癌症免疫和干性的调控，涉及表观遗传和机器学习分析，但核心是基因表达与表观修饰，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Cancer is one of the main causes of human death. Here, we focus on the B-cell lymphoma 7 protein family member B (BCL7B) gene, an accessory subunit of the SWI/SNF chromatin-remodelling complex. To characterize the function of BCL7B, heterozygous BCL7B-deficient stomach cancer cell lines were generated with the CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing system. The comprehensive gene expression patterns were compared between parental cells and each DeltaBCL7B cell line by RNA-seq. The results showed marked downregulation of immune-related genes and upregulation of stemness-related genes in the DeltaBCL7B cell lines. Moreover, by ChIP-seq analysis with H3K27me3 antibody, the changes of epigenetic modification sequences were compared between parental cells and each DeltaBCL7B cell line. After machine learning, we detected the centroid sequence changes, which exerted an impact on antigen presentation. The regulation of BCL7B expression in cancer cells gives rise to cancer stem cell-like characteristics and the acquisition of an immune evasion phenotype.
abstract_zh: 癌症是人类死亡的主要原因之一。在此，我们聚焦于B细胞淋巴瘤7蛋白家族成员B（BCL7B）基因，它是SWI/SNF染色质重塑复合体的一个辅助亚基。为了表征BCL7B的功能，我们利用CRISPR/Cas9基因组编辑系统生成了杂合BCL7B缺陷的胃癌细胞系。通过RNA-seq比较了亲本细胞与每个DeltaBCL7B细胞系之间的全面基因表达模式。结果显示，在DeltaBCL7B细胞系中，免疫相关基因显著下调，而干性相关基因上调。此外，利用H3K27me3抗体进行ChIP-seq分析，比较了亲本细胞与每个DeltaBCL7B细胞系之间的表观遗传修饰序列变化。经过机器学习，我们检测到了中心序列变化，这些变化对抗原呈递产生了影响。癌细胞中BCL7B表达的调控导致了癌症干细胞样特性的出现以及免疫逃逸表型的获得。
